description: Wasserschutzgebiete Steiermark is a dataset listed in inspire.gv.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.steiermark.at. Water protection areas of the Water Information System, areas with water permit in the water book. (INSPIRE Annex III). Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Water protection areas Styria" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include HighValueDataset, inspireidentifiziert, Steiermark, Wasserschutz, Schutzgebiete, OGD - Open Data Österreich. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2021-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-bmlfuw-at.
